authorization.scope: Complete only V2 Milestone 3 under the existing contract.
authorization.verbatim: If everything looks great, lets move to milestone 3, or there is contract renegotiation you need?

evaluation.candidate_definition: For each non-UNKNOWN state, select LONG or SHORT by the higher mean net return after frozen costs. All other states map to NO_BIAS.
sequence: Evaluate all declared individual-variable states within each session.
Evaluate only the 17 declared two-condition interaction states within each session.
Apply one Benjamini-Hochberg correction family to all support-eligible individual and interaction states within that session.
Apply the frozen lead gates and known-hypothesis exclusions.
Rank with the frozen deterministic order.

feature_design.reuse_policy: Reuse transforms, feature_universe, and interactions byte-for-byte by semantic value. No field, state, threshold, or interaction may be added after this manifest is frozen.
feature_design.tertile_fit: Fit TYPE-7 33.333333% and 66.666667% thresholds separately by session on all 2021-2024 development cases for Milestone 3 only. Milestone 4 must refit thresholds within each expanding training fold.
feature_design.unknown_policy: Missing, stale, unavailable, or roll-crossing values remain UNKNOWN and are excluded from the affected state; they are never confirmation.

known_hypotheses.declared_interactions_involving_zn: Eligible as materially distinct frozen two-condition development hypotheses, but receive no independent-validation credit.

london_single_zn_4h.reason: The London-only ZN rule was selected after its 2024 London result was known and is governed separately as LONDON_ZN_4H_POSTHOC_V0_1.

new_york_single_zn_4h.reason: The unchanged New York component belonged to the rejected universal ZN rule and cannot be renamed as a fresh discovery.

lead_gate.meaning: A Milestone 3 lead is only eligible for expanding walk-forward stability in Milestone 4. It is not a validated edge and is not yet a frozen candidate.
requirements: not excluded by the known-hypothesis policy
mean net return after frozen costs above zero
mean net return beats the same-session same-direction unconditional development control
positive selected-direction mean in both chronological halves
positive selected-direction mean in at least three adequately supported calendar years
lower bound of the ISO-week cluster-bootstrap 95% interval above zero

outcome.primary_measure: mean net return basis points after observed spread, frozen slippage, and frozen commission

order: Benjamini-Hochberg q-value ascending with null last
cluster-bootstrap lower 95% mean net return descending
excess mean net return versus same-direction control descending

support_and_stability.chronological_halves: Within each session, sort all 2021-2024 development cases by decision time and split at the median case count.
support_and_stability.stability_flag: positive selected-direction mean in both chronological halves and at least three calendar-year buckets with at least ten cases

confidence_interval.seed: SHA-256 of this manifest hash, session, relationship_id, and state

multiple_testing.family: all support-eligible individual and declared interaction states within each session

uncertainty_and_multiplicity.selection_adjustment: Double the one-sided normal-approximation p-value because LONG versus SHORT is selected on development data.
